title: Record the T488 composition moment straddle
body:
## Summary
- The published T488 profile has rank mass `65088 * 488`, and its moment is negative at `0.001730418899766071163804` and positive one unit of `10^-24` later.
- The 70-digit released string is that lower endpoint minus `10^-46` and `10^-70`, and it stays above the selected kappa. No word replay and no new kappa.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/t488-moment-straddle/verify.py`
